body: Q13 landed and is closed - reviewed function by function, test re-run independently. One defect I fixed rather than sending back: ROPES_MARGIN was declared and never read, place_of tested both branches against CORNER_MARGIN. Identical while both are 0.75, silently wrong the moment they diverge. No behavioural test could catch that, so the gate is now a source assertion that place_of references both. Worth carrying forward: a constant you expose but never read is a defect even when the numbers agree. You now own Q14, Quantise.gd - C62 said replay survives a fixed step ONLY with quantised state, so this is that condition made buildable. The trap is ties: to_fixed(0.0005) and to_fixed(-0.0005) must be 1 and -1, half away from zero, symmetric. Get it wrong and replay drifts. TASK_Q14.md is self-contained.
